summary: The retrieved documents describe the "WorksheetPreview" module within the HSPnet.DataLayer. This module is responsible for handling data related to educational departments, programs, cohorts, terms, courses, and their associated worksheets. It includes functionalities for retrieving data, as well as setting session-related variables based on conditions applied during the retrieval.
purpose: The purpose of "WorksheetPreview" is to facilitate the management and retrieval of worksheet-related data, ensuring correct handling of various educational and administrative conditions.

workflows.name: GetByStat
steps: Initialize a list to store WorksheetPreview data
Set the procedure name to GroupWorksheetListNotProcessed
Add required parameters including SessionID, ProgramID, PlacCoordID, DateFrom, DateTo, CourseID, and CohortID
Set GroupFlag based on Stat value
Execute procedure and retrieve data using SqlDataReader
Process data, set session variables, and save variables

workflows.name: GroupWorksheetGetSearchKeys
steps: Set and save session variables based on Stat value

business_rules: Use EnrollmentMode parameter when Stat is STUENROL
Use GroupFlag based on Stat value (1 for GWS or GWSASSIGN, 0 otherwise)
validations: Check if SqlDataReader is not null before reading data
Ensure Count is not zero before creating a WorksheetPreview entry
calculations: Count retrieval is based on different Stat conditions such as GWS, IWSCFO, STUENROL, GWSASSIGN, IWSASSIGN
conditions: Stat condition checks for setting parameters and retrieving Count values
system_behavior: Sess.DB handles parameter addition and procedure execution
Sess.SetVariable and Sess.SaveVariables manage session state
